entities.name: daily-workflow
observations: Path: src/memory/DAILY_WORKFLOW.md
Purpose: canonical daily memory workflow for AI agents and engineers
Standard loop: pre-task -> inspect -> confirm -> perform -> post-task -> promote
Pre-task: python -m memory.tooling.workflow pre-task --task-id <id> --title <task>
Post-task: python -m memory.tooling.workflow post-task --task-id <id> --title <task> --summary <result>
Curated review: python -m memory.tooling.workflow review-curated
Memory is source-first: runtime truth stays in src/bioetl/, docs/, configs/, tests/

Standard workflow: audit(baseline) -> plan -> test(baseline) -> implementation -> test(final) -> doc -> audit(final)
